notes: Single endpoint /traffic-alerts: live Google Maps traffic incidents (accidents, construction, road closures, slowdowns) inside a bounding box (bottom_left / top_right as lat,lng). Returns every alert in the box in one call (no pagination) at data.alerts[] (type, latitude, longitude) with data.count. The box area is capped per zoom (11: 8000 km2, 12: 2000, 13: 500 default, 14: 125, 15: 30, 16: 8); use a lower zoom to cover a larger area, or tile a large region into several boxes. For Waze driver-reported alerts and jams use the waze API.
